notes: The US spec sheet for the Supersonic (120 V, 60 Hz, 1600 W for the whole dryer) supplies the motor, ioniser and cord. The cut-out comes from the HD07 safety leaflet and the rare-earth figure from the French HD07 environmental sheet, so they may not describe the US version.

gaps: The US spec sheet prints no model code; HD07 comes from its file name. The leaflet (HD07 on its cover) and the French sheet (model reference HD07) name HD07 for the Supersonic but are not US documents, so the US tie rests on the file name and shared name.
The spec sheet gives 'Dyson digital motor V9' at 110,000 rpm; it gives no brushless statement, voltage or power for the motor. motor_bldc is the nearest part type, not a sourced statement.
1600 W is for the whole dryer, so it is not put on the motor or any heater. The 120 V input is the dryer's, so it is not put on the cord.
The leaflet calls the cut-out non-self-resetting but does not name its type (bimetal or fuse).
No ioniser part type exists; transformer_hv is the nearest high-voltage type and is not a claim that the module holds a transformer.
The leaflet says the appliance, filter and attachments contain magnets; the environmental sheet gives rare earths for the product as a whole. The two are not tied to each other.

No heating element, circuit board, thermistor or switch is described in the HD07 sources, so none is claimed. Dyson technology pages and the Dyson US product pages returned HTTP 403 and were not used.
method: Dyson US technical specification for the Supersonic, version 1/24 (Dyson PDF, file name US_Supersonic_HD07_Tech_Spec_2024), read as text and as rendered pages.
Dyson Supersonic HD07 regulatory compliance and safety leaflet, English section (Dyson PDF), read as text; cover rendered.
Dyson Supersonic HD07 environmental data sheet, French, updated 13 Oct 2023 (Dyson PDF), read as text and rendered.
ChargerLAB teardown of the Dyson HD19 Supersonic Travel was read by the researcher and not used (different model, China market).

comps.spec: Dyson digital motor V9, 110,000 rpm, per the US spec sheet.
Magnets: the HD07 safety leaflet warns that the appliance, its filter and its attachments contain magnets. The environmental sheet says the HD07 contains at least 15,240 mg of rare earths.
Non-self-resetting thermal cut-out against overheating. After a cut-out the leaflet says to unplug the dryer and let it cool.
Ioniser listed on the US spec sheet: negative ions to help reduce static in the hair.
Power cable, 8 ft 10 in (2.7 m) long, per the US spec sheet.
